title: LocalCmdCommand is a 1,270-line god-class mixing four subsystems
existing_state: Services/Scripting/Commands/LocalCmdCommand.cs packs roughly 45 members spanning four distinct subsystems into one file: three execution modes (ExecuteForeground at 148, ExecuteBackground at 284, ExecuteInteractive at 362), a shell command-line construction layer (BuildProcessArgs/BuildInteractiveArgs/quoting/PowerShell encoding, lines 524-1044), a transcript-audit pipeline for interactive sessions (PrepareInteractiveAuditCapture through CleanupInteractiveAuditCapture, 673-986), and a process-wide background-process registry held in static dictionaries with an AppDomain.ProcessExit hook (lines 21-23, 1056-1165), plus the IProcessRunner/SystemProcessHandle seam classes (1193-1266). The audit pipeline already bends execution semantics to fit in (cmd interactive sessions get rewritten into `( cmd ) 2>&1 | powershell Tee-Object`, changing pipeline/exit-code behavior of the audited command, ~694-697), and any change to quoting or lifetime rules requires reasoning about all three modes at once. This is the largest command in the engine by 3-4x and the most frequently extended (confirm modes, lifetimes, audit, seams).
recommendation: Split along the natural seams that already exist as method clusters: a `LocalShellCommandBuilder` (shell resolution + quoting + encoding, the `internal static` builders are already pure functions with tests in mind), a `BackgroundProcessRegistry` (the static tracking + cleanup + ProcessExit hook), and an `InteractiveAuditCapture` service; keep LocalCmdCommand as the thin dispatcher over foreground/background/interactive. No behavior change — file moves plus visibility adjustments (`InternalsVisibleTo` already covers the test project).
user_benefit: The most security-sensitive and most-extended command in the engine becomes reviewable in isolation; quoting or lifetime fixes stop requiring a mental model of 1,270 lines, reducing the regression rate in a class that launches arbitrary local processes.

evidence.note: ExecuteAsync dispatching three execution modes plus confirmation flow
shell/arg construction and quoting layer (internal static, already seam-shaped)
static process registry + AppDomain.ProcessExit cleanup — a process-wide subsystem living inside a command class
IProcessRunner seam and SystemProcessHandle in the same file
